title: ophrys mammosa subsp. cyclocheila
intro: Ophrys mammosa subsp. cyclocheila, commonly known as the Bee Orchid, is a unique and fascinating plant belonging to the Orchidaceae family. This plant is used in traditional medicine due to its numerous health benefits, which include treating conditions such as fever, rheumatism, and coughs. The therapeutic actions of Ophrys mammosa subsp. cyclocheila include anti-inflammatory, antipyretic, and expectorant properties, making it a valuable remedy for various ailments. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
